arabic_text: إنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ وَخَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مَعَهُمْ فِي دَارِ السَّلاَمِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
transliteration: innaka anta at-tawwabu ar-rahīmu wa khayru al-ghāfirīn wa-ijʿalna maʿahum fi daris-salam bi-rahmatika ya arhamar-rahimīn
english_text: "Surely Thou art Ever-turning, All-compassionate" (2:128) and the Best of forgivers, and place us with them in the Abode of Peace, through Thy mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ هَذَا يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ، يَوْمٌ شَرَّفْتَهُ وَكَرَّمْتَهُ وَعَظَّمْتَهُ، نَشَرْتَ فِيهِ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَمَنَنْتَ فِيهِ بِعَفْوِكَ وَأَجْزَلْتَ فِيهِ عَطِيَّتَكَ، وَتَفَضَّلْتَ بِهِ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ.
transliteration: allāhumma hādhā yawmu ʿarafah yawmun sharraftahu wa karramatahu wa ʿadhdhamtahu, nashartafihi rahmatika wa manantan fihi bi'afwik-a wa ajzalt-a fihi `atiyyatak-a wa tafaddal-ta bihi 'ala 'ibadik
english_text: O God, this is the Day of 'Arafa, a day which Thou hast made noble, given honour, and magnified. Within it Thou hast spread Thy mercy, showed kindness through Thy pardon, and made plentiful Thy giving, and by it Thou hast been bounteous toward Thy servants.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ الَّذِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَبْلَ خَلْقِكَ لَهُ، وَبَعْدَ خَلْقِكَ إيَّاهُ،
transliteration: allahumma wa ana 'abduka alladhi an'amta 'alayhi qabla khalqika lahu, wa ba'da khalqika iyyahu
english_text: I am Thy servant whom Thou favoured before creating him and after creating him.

arabic_text: فَجَعَلْتَهُ مِمَّنْ هَدَيْتَهُ لِدِينِكَ، وَوَفَّقْتَهُ لِحَقِّكَ، وَعَصَمْتَهُ بِحَبْلِكَ، وَأَدْخَلْتَهُ فِيْ حِزْبِكَ، وَأَرْشَدْتَهُ لِمُوَالاَةِ أَوْليآئِكَ، وَمُعَادَاةِ أَعْدَائِكَ، ثُمَّ أَمَرْتَهُ فَلَمْ يَأْتَمِرْ،
transliteration: fajaʿaltahu mimmān hadaytahu lī dīnik wa waffaqtahu lihaqqika, wa ʿasamtahu bihablika wa adkhaltahu fi hizbika, wa arshadtahu limuwalaat al-awliyaa'ik wa muʿādaāti aʿdāʾika, thumma amartahu falammā yatamir
english_text: Thou madest him one of those whom Thou guided to Thy religion, gavest success in fulfilling Thy right, preserved through Thy cord, included within Thy party, and directed aright to befriend Thy friends and show enmity to Thine enemies. Then Thou commanded him, but he did not follow Thy commands,

arabic_text: وَزَجَرْتَهُ فَلَمْ يَنْزَجِرْ، وَنَهَيْتَهُ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ فَخَالَفَ أَمْرَكَ إلَى نَهْيِكَ، لاَ مُعَانَدَةً لَكَ وَلاَ اسْتِكْبَاراً عَلَيْكَ،
transliteration: wa-zajartahu falam yanzajir, wa-nahaytahu ʿan maʿsiyatk, fakhalafa amrak ila nahyik lā muʿānadatan laka wa lā istikbāran ʿalayk
english_text: Thou restricted Him, but he did not heed Thy restrictions, Thou prohibited him from disobedience toward Thee, but he broke Thy command by doing what Thou hadst prohibited, not in contention with Thee, nor to display pride toward Thee;

arabic_text: بَلْ دَعَاهُ هَوَاهُ إلَى مَا زَيَّلْتَهُ، وَإلَى مَا حَذَّرْتَهُ، وَأَعَانَهُ عَلَى ذالِكَ عَدُوُّكَ وَعَدُوُّهُ،
transliteration: bal daʿāhu hawāhu ilā mā zayyaltahu wa-ilā mā ḥaḏḏartahu wa'aʿānahū ʿalā dhālika ʿaduwwuka wa ʿaduwwuhu
english_text: on the contrary, his caprice called him to that which Thou hadst set apart and cautioned against, and he was helped in that by Thy enemy and his enemy.

arabic_text: فَأَقْدَمَ عَلَيْهِ عَارِفاً بِوَعِيْدِكَ، رَاجِياً لِعَفْوِكَ، وَاثِقاً بِتَجَاوُزِكَ، وَكَانَ أَحَقَّ عِبَادِكَ ـ مَعَ مَا مَنَنْتَ عَلَيْهِ ـ أَلاَّ يَفْعَلَ،
transliteration: fa'aqdamah ʿalayhi ʿaarifan bi-waʿiidika, raji'an li-ʿafwik waāthiqan bi-tajāwuzika, wa kāna aḥaqqa ʿibādika maʿa manantan ʿalayhi, ʾalā yafʿal
english_text: So he went ahead with it knowing Thy threat, hoping for Thy pardon, and relying upon Thy forbearance, though he was the most obligated of Thy servants - given Thy kindness toward him - not to do so.

arabic_text: وَهَا أَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ صَاغِراً، ذَلِيلاً، خَاضِعَاً، خَاشِعاً، خَائِفَاً، مُعْتَرِفاً بِعَظِيم مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ تَحَمَّلْتُهُ، وَجَلِيْل مِنَ الْخَطَايَا اجْتَرَمْتُهُ،
transliteration: wa-ha-a-na dhaa bayna yadayka saaghiran ẓalīlan, khāḍiʿan, khāshiʿan, khāʾifan muʿtarifan biʿaẓīmin mina aldhunūbi taḥammaltuhu wa jalil min al-khataaya ajtaramtuhu
english_text: Here I am, then, before Thee, despised, lowly, humble, abject, fearful, confessing the dreadful sins with which I am burdened and the great offenses that I have committed,

arabic_text: مُسْتَجِيراً بِصَفْحِكَ، لائِذاً بِرَحْمَتِكَ، مُوقِناً أَنَّهُ لاَ يُجِيرُنِي مِنْكَ مُجِيرٌ، وَلاَ يَمْنَعُنِي مِنْكَ مَانِعٌ .
transliteration: mustajīran bi-ṣafḥika, lā’iḏan bi-raḥmatika muqinan annahu la yujiruni minka mujeerun wa lā yamnaʿunī minka māniʿ
english_text: seeking sanctuary in Thy forgiveness, asking shelter in Thy mercy, and certain that no sanctuary-giver will give me sanctuary from Thee and no withholder will hold me back from Thee.

arabic_text: فَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِمَا تَعُودُ بِهِ عَلَى مَنِ اقْتَرَفَ مِنْ تَغَمُّدِكَ، وَجُدْ عَلَيَّ بِمَا تَجُودُ بِهِ عَلَى مَنْ أَلْقَى بِيَدِهِ إلَيْكَ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ، وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِمَا لاَ يَتَعَاظَمُكَ أَنْ تَمُنَّ بِهِ عَلَى مَنْ أَمَّلَكَ مِنْ غُفْرَانِكَ،
transliteration: faʿud ʿalayya bima taʿudu bihi ʿala mani iqtarafa min taghammudika wa juud 'alayya bimā tajūdu bihī 'alā man 'alqā biyadihī 'ilayka min 'afwik wa-amnun ʿalayya bimā lā yataʿāẓamu-ka an tamunna bihi ʿalā man ammalaka min ghufraanika
english_text: So act kindly toward me, just as Thou actest kindly by Thy shielding him who commits sins, be munificent toward me, just as Thou art munificent by pardoning him who throws himself before Thee, and show kindness to me, just as it is nothing great for Thee to show kindness by forgiving him who expectantly hopes in Thee!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ لِي فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ نَصِيباً أَنَالُ بِهِ حَظّاً مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ، وَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي صِفْراً مِمَّا يَنْقَلِبُ بِهِ الْمُتَعَبِّدُونَ لَكَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ،
transliteration: wa-jaʿal li fī hādhā al-yawm naṣīban anālu bihi ḥaẓẓan min riḍwānik wa lā taruddanī ṣifran mimmā yanqalibu bihi al-mutaʿabbidūna laka min ʿibādik.
english_text: Appoint for me in this day an allotment through which I may attain a share of Thy good pleasure, and send me not back destitute of that with which Thy worshipers return from among Thy servants!

arabic_text: وَإنِّي وَإنْ لَمْ أُقَدِّمْ مَا قَدَّمُوهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ، فَقَد قَدَّمْتُ تَوْحِيدَكَ، وَنَفْيَ الاَضْدَادِ وَالاَنْدَادِ وَالاشْبَاهِ عَنْكَ، وَأَتَيْتُكَ مِنَ الاَبْوَابِ الَّتِي أَمَرْتَ أَنْ تُؤْتى مِنْها،
transliteration: wa-innī wa-in lam uqaddim mā qaddamūhu mina al-ṣāliḥāt faqad qaddamtu tawḥīdaka wa nafiya al-adad wa al-andad wa al-ashbah ʿanka wa ʾataytu-ka mina al-abwābi allatī ʾamarta ʾan tuʾta minhā
english_text: Though I have not forwarded the righteous deeds which they have forwarded, I have forwarded the profession of Thy Unity and the negation from Thee of opposites, rivals, and likenesses, I have come to Thee by the gateways by which Thou hast commanded that people come,

arabic_text: وَتَقَرَّبْتُ إلَيْكَ بِمَا لاَ يَقْرُبُ ، أَحَدٌ مِنْكَ إلاَّ بِالتَّقَرُّبِ بِهِ
transliteration: wa taqarrabtu ilayka bima la yaqrubu ʾaḥadun minka illā bit-taqarrub bih
english_text: and I have sought nearness to Thee through that, without seeking nearness through which, none gains nearness to Thee.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعْتُ ذلِكَ بِالاِنابَةِ إلَيْكَ، وَالتَّذَلُّلِ وَالاسْتِكَانَةِ لَكَ، وَحُسْنِ الظَّنِّ بِكَ، وَالثِّقَةِ بِمَا عِنْدَكَ،
transliteration: thumma attabaʿtu dhalika bil-inabati ilayka wa al-tazallul wa al-istikānaẗi laka, wa ḥusni al-żann bi-ka, wa al-ṯiqāẗi bi-mā ʿind
english_text: Then I followed all this with repeated turning toward Thee, lowliness and abasement before Thee, good opinion of Thee, and trust in what is with Thee;

arabic_text: وَشَفَعْتُهُ بِرَجآئِكَ الَّذِي قَلَّ مَا يَخِيبُ عَلَيْهِ رَاجِيْكَ،
transliteration: wa-shafaʿtuhu bi-rajāʾika al-ladhi qalla ma yakhību ʿalayhi rājīk
english_text: and to that I coupled hope in Thee, since the one who hopes in Thee is seldom disappointed!

arabic_text: وَسَأَلْتُكَ مَسْأَلَةَ الْحَقِيرِ الذّلِيلِ الْبَائِسِ الْفَقِيْرِ الْخَائِفِ الْمُسْتَجِيرِ،
transliteration: wa saʾaltuka masʾalata al-ḥaqīri al-dḫalīl al-bāʾisi al-faqīri al-khāʾifi al-mustajīri
english_text: I asked Thee with the asking of one vile, lowly, pitiful, poor, fearful, seeking sanctuary;

arabic_text: وَمَعَ ذَلِكَ خِيفَةً وَتَضَرُّعاً وَتَعَوُّذاً وَتَلَوُّذاً، لاَ مُسْتَطِيلاً بِتَكبُّرِ الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ، وَلاَ مُتَعَالِياً بِدالَّةِ الْمُطِيعِينَ، وَلاَ مُسْتَطِيلاً بِشَفَاعَةِ الشَّافِعِينَ،
transliteration: wa maʿa dhalika khīfatan wa taḍarruʿan wa taʿawwudhan wa talawwuḏan lā mustaṭīlan bi takabburi al-mutakabbirīn walā mutaʿālīyan bidallati al-muṭīʿīn walā mustaṭīlan bi-shafāʿati sh-shāfiʿīn
english_text: all that in fear and pleading, seeking refuge and asking shelter, not presumptuous through the pride of the proud, nor exalting myself with the boldness of the obedient, nor presumptuous of the intercession of the interceders.

arabic_text: وَأَنَا بَعْدُ أَقَلُّ الاَقَلِّيْنَ، وَأَذَلُّ الاَذَلِّينَ، وَمِثْلُ الذَّرَّةِ أَوْ دُونَهَا.
transliteration: wa ana baʿdu aqallu al-aqallin, wa adhallu al-adhallin wa mithlu aldharrati awdunaha
english_text: For I am still the least of the least and the lowliest of the lowly, like a dust mote or less!

arabic_text: فَيَا مَنْ لَمْ يَعَاجِلِ الْمُسِيئِينَ، وَلاَ يَنْدَهُ الْمُتْرَفِينَ،
transliteration: fayā man lam yaʿājili al-musīʾīna, walā yandahū al-mutrāfīna
english_text: O He who does not hurry the evildoers nor restrain those living in ease!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يَمُنُّ بِإقَالَةِ الْعَاثِرِينَ، وَيَتَفَضَّلُ بإنْظَارِ الْخَاطِئِينَ،
transliteration: wayā man yamunnu bi-iqālati al-ʿāthirīna, wa yatafaḍḍalu bi-inẓāri al-khāṭiʾ
english_text: O He who shows kindness through releasing the stumblers and gratuitous bounty through respiting the offenders!

arabic_text: أَنَا الْمُسِيءُ الْمُعْتَرِفُ الْخَاطِئُ الْعَاثِرُ،
transliteration: ana al-musii'u al-mu'tarifu al-khaati'u al-aathiru
english_text: I am the evildoer, the confessor, the offender, the stumbler!

arabic_text: أَنَا الَّذِيْ أَقْدَمَ عَلَيْكَ مُجْتَرِئاً،
transliteration: ana alladhī aqdamu ʿalayka mujtarīʾan
english_text: I am he who was audacious toward Thee as one insolent!

arabic_text: أَنَا الَّذِي عَصَاكَ مُتَعَمِّداً،
transliteration: anā alladhī ʿaṣāka mutaʿammidan
english_text: I am he who disobeyed Thee with forethought!

arabic_text: أَنَا الَّذِي اسْتَخْفى مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَبَارَزَكَ،
transliteration: anā alladhī astakhfā min ʿibādika wa bārazaka
english_text: I am he who hid myself from Thy servants and blatantly showed myself to Thee!

arabic_text: أَنَا الَّذِي هَابَ عِبَادَكَ وَأَمِنَكَ
transliteration: anā alladhī hāba ʿibādaka wa aminka
english_text: I am he who was awed by Thy servants and felt secure from Thee!

arabic_text: أَنَا الَّذِي لَمْ يَرْهَبْ سَطْوَتَكَ وَلَمْ يَخَفْ بَأْسَكَ
transliteration: anā alladhī lam yarhab saṭwatka wa lam yakhaf basaka
english_text: I am he who dreaded not Thy penalty and feared not Thy severity!

arabic_text: أَنَا الْجَانِي عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، أَنَا الْمُرْتَهَنُ بِبَلِيَّتِهِ،
transliteration: ana al-jani `ala nafsihi, ana al-murtahanu bi-baliyyatihi
english_text: I am the offender against himself! I am the hostage to his own affliction!

arabic_text: الْقَلِيلُ الْحَيَاءِ، أَنَا الطَّوِيلُ الْعَنآءِ،
transliteration: al-qalīlu al-ḥayāʾi, anā al-ṭawīlu al-ʿanāʾi
english_text: I am short in shame! I am long in suffering!

arabic_text: بِحَقِّ مَنِ انْتَجَبْتَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَبِمَنِ اصْطَفَيْتَهُ لِنَفْسِكَ،
transliteration: biḥaqqi mani intajabta min khalkika wa bimani-stafaytahu li nafsika
english_text: By the right of him whom Thou hast distinguished among Thy creation and by him whom Thou hast chosen for Thyself!

arabic_text: بِحَقِّ مَنِ اخْتَرْتَ مِنْ بَريَّتِكَ، وَمَنِ اجْتَبَيْتَ لِشَأْنِكَ،
transliteration: biḥaqqi mani ikhtartamin barīyatika, wa mani ijtabayta li-shaʾnik
english_text: By the right of him whom Thou hast selected from among Thy creatures and by him whom Thou hast picked for Thy task!
